d974064039c089df.title: Billy Nation: A Tribute To Billy Joel
d974064039c089df.desc: Experience the music of Billy Joel brought to life with stunning authenticity as Billy Nation delivers a concert packed with songs that defined a generation. Fronted by Adam Shapiro - whose father was a real New York piano man - the band captures the sound, style, and storytelling that made Billy Joel one of the most iconic artists of all time. Enjoy classics like "Piano Man," "My Life," "Movin' Out," "You May Be Right," "Just the Way You Are," "Scenes from an Italian Restaurant," and more, performed with the signature grand piano, soaring sax lines, rich harmonies, and world-class musicianship that fans expect. Billy Nation has toured across North America, entertaining thousands and earning recognition as San Diego Magazine's 2024 Best Tribute Band. With a full band on stage and every song performed 100% live, this is the closest you can get to experiencing Billy Joel in concert. Everyone entering the theatre must have a paid ticket regardless of age or seating requirements. All sales are final. No refunds or exchanges.
